# TPC-H SF100: DuckDB and Umbra

DuckDB 1.5.6 and Umbra, each with the 8 primary keys and 7 foreign keys of [`benchmarks/tpc-h/schema.sql`](../../../benchmarks/tpc-h/schema.sql) declared. Each cell is the median of 3 hot executions after 1 warm execution, in ms, at 1 / 32 / 64 threads.

## Files

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| [`times.json`](times.json) | The time of every cell (ms), per query, binding and thread count |
| [`run_baselines.py`](run_baselines.py) | The timing runner: one block per engine, query, binding and thread count, 1 warm and 3 hot executions |
| [`aggregate.py`](aggregate.py) | The median of each block's hot executions: `times.json` |
| [`load/`](load/) | The schema with the keys (`constrained-schema.sql`), the DuckDB load (`load_duckdb.py`), the Umbra load (`umbra_load_sql.py`, `umbra-create-load.sql`, `umbra_run.sh`) and the Umbra server (`umbra_server.sh`) |
